nodes.label: React Vite Redux Tailwind Frontend
nodes.rationale: README states the application stack is React 19, Vite, Redux Toolkit, and Tailwind CSS 3 for a frontend-only MVP.

nodes.label: MiniComparator Main Feature
nodes.rationale: README identifies src/components/MiniComparator as the main feature containing FilterPanel, ComparisonTable, and ColumnSelector.

nodes.label: Wheel Properties Registry
nodes.rationale: Frontend README describes src/config/wheelProperties.jsx as the source of truth for wheel properties, filters, sorts, and columns.

nodes.label: Wheelset Pair Catalog Unit
nodes.rationale: Domain vocabulary defines a wheelset as the fundamental catalog entry representing a front and rear pair sold together.

nodes.label: Product Variant
nodes.rationale: Domain vocabulary defines product variants as documented purchasable configurations represented as their own comparator rows.

nodes.label: Design Tokens
nodes.rationale: Domain vocabulary defines surface and radius tokens such as paper-0, paper-1, radius-xs, and radius-pill.

nodes.label: Lab Instrument Editorial Blueprint Aesthetic
nodes.rationale: Design system README describes the visual direction as lab-instrument, editorial, and engineering-blueprint with warm paper, deep ink, brass accent, and sage neutral.

nodes.label: Token Usage Rules
nodes.rationale: Implementation guide requires production UI to use CSS variables for colors, typography classes for type, spacing tokens, radius tokens, and motion tokens.

nodes.label: Design System Preview Specimens
nodes.rationale: Design system README identifies preview files as atomic design-system specimen cards rendered in the Design System tab.

nodes.label: Swappable Accent Axis
nodes.rationale: Accent preview shows Brass, Cobalt, Oxblood, and Forest as accent options that override the brass ramp.

nodes.label: Base Palettes
nodes.rationale: Palette preview presents Paper, Mist, and Porcelain base palettes and documents default and alternate pairings.

nodes.label: Status Badges
nodes.rationale: Badge preview shows pill, square metadata, delta, availability, and roadmap badge examples.

nodes.label: Iconography
nodes.rationale: Preview defines Lucide-style icons with 1.4px strokes, square caps, miter joins, 24px boxes, and currentColor inheritance.

nodes.label: Input Controls
nodes.rationale: Preview demonstrates text inputs, focused state, numeric range pair, and checkbox controls.

nodes.label: Brand Identity
nodes.rationale: Preview shows the mark, standard wordmark variants, and credential stamp for MyBikeLab road wheels.

nodes.label: Visual Motifs
nodes.rationale: Preview names grid backgrounds, ticker data bands, and crosshair datum frames as reusable visual motifs.

nodes.label: Radii System
nodes.rationale: Preview states most surfaces are square and maps none, xs, sm, and pill radii to surfaces such as inputs, buttons, chips, and status badges.

nodes.label: Hairline Divider System
nodes.rationale: Preview defines rule-strong, rule, rule-faint, and rule-double as divider styles.

nodes.label: Spacing Scale
nodes.rationale: Preview defines a 4px-based spacing scale from 4px through 80px.

nodes.label: Data Stat Components
nodes.rationale: Preview demonstrates mono stat blocks, serif display stat variant, and compact key/value lists.

nodes.label: Spec Table
nodes.rationale: Preview defines a spec table with tabular numerals, hairline rows, hover tint, badges, and wheel sample rows.

nodes.label: Display Typography
nodes.rationale: Preview lists display type tokens t-display-1, t-display-2, and t-display-light with Inter weights, line heights, and tracking.

nodes.label: Type Families
nodes.rationale: Preview identifies Inter weights 300/400/600/800 and JetBrains Mono weights 400/500/600, including tabular numerals and disabled ligatures.

nodes.label: Mono and Label Typography
nodes.rationale: Preview defines t-mono-lg, t-mono, t-numeric, t-label, t-eyebrow, and t-annotation tokens.

nodes.label: Sans Typography
nodes.rationale: Preview defines t-h1 through t-h4, t-lead, t-body, and t-body-sm tokens for headings and body copy.

nodes.label: MyBikeLab Product
nodes.rationale: Overview describes MyBikeLab as a web platform for structured bike component data and comparison tools, starting with road wheels.

nodes.label: Road Wheel Comparator
nodes.rationale: Overview names the comparator as the MVP's main interactive feature for browsing, filtering, sorting, comparing, column visibility, and minimum retailer prices.

nodes.label: Product Roadmap
nodes.rationale: Overview defines three phases: components comparison, impact simulator, and full bike configurator.

nodes.label: Comparator UI Kit
nodes.rationale: README describes a faithful recreation of the wheel comparator as a precision spec-sheet with filters, sort, column controls, filter chips, and 15 wheels.

nodes.label: Landing Page UI Kit
nodes.rationale: README describes the landing page kit using the Notebook direction, palette/accent tweaks, and sections from navbar through footer.

nodes.label: Palette Persistence
nodes.rationale: README states chosen base palette and accent are written to localStorage keys mbl-palette and mbl-accent so comparator and wheel-detail inherit them.

nodes.label: Wheel Detail UI Kit
nodes.rationale: README describes a single-wheel spec sheet with breadcrumb, title block, schematic side, spec sheet, retailer ladder, comparable wheels, and price disclaimer.

nodes.label: Shared Design Tokens
nodes.rationale: The preview and UI kit HTML files link the shared colors_and_type.css stylesheet or use its token variables such as paper, ink, brass, font-sans, and font-mono.

nodes.label: Affiliate Link Region And Stock Metadata
nodes.norm_label: affiliate link region and stock metadata
